title: ASICS Marathon de Paris 2027 — Official FAQ (registration, lottery, fees, course status)
publisher: ASICS Marathon de Paris (organiser official website)
claims: The 50th edition of the ASICS Marathon de Paris will take place on 4 April 2027.

The lottery runs from 8 to 30 September 2026; entering the lottery is free and one registration per person; the date and time of entry do not affect chances; unsuccessful entrants are automatically re-entered into subsequent draws.
Draw results are published from 1 October 2026; selected runners have 72 hours from the results email to register and pay; after that deadline the place goes to another runner.
The general entry fee for 2027 is a fixed €169; a special fee exists for 2026-2027 FFA-licensed runners meeting the conditions; payment is only requested if selected in the draw.
The lottery registration right is personal and non-transferable; once purchased, the bib is personal and non-transferable and cannot be transferred to another person.
Minimum age: runners must be born on 31 December 2007 at the latest; teams of 2 to 6 people enter together with one shared draw result, but each runs separately on race day.
The 2027 course has not yet been announced; start and finish lines, access routes and practical race-day information will be published in the run-up to the event.

Medical certificate or PPS requirements for 2027 will follow the 2027 race regulations and be indicated before the event; cancellation and refund conditions are those in the rules and terms of sale accepted at registration.
